items.distractor_fact: A szomszédos városban ugyanezen a reggelen {D} fokot mértek.
items.gloss_en: In the neighbouring town, {D} degrees was measured that same morning.
items.entity_note: a different town's own thermometer, not the noon/morning readings of this story's thermometer

items.distractor_fact: A tőzsdén egy másik termék napi záróára {D} dollár volt.
items.gloss_en: On the exchange, a different product's daily closing price was {D} dollars.
items.entity_note: a different traded product, not the one whose opening and closing price are compared

items.distractor_fact: A szomszédos tó vízszintje ugyanazon a hétvégén {D} méteren állt.
items.gloss_en: The neighbouring lake's water level stood at {D} meters that same weekend.
items.entity_note: a different lake, not the one whose level change since the start of the week is asked about

items.distractor_fact: Egy másik drón ugyanezen a napon {D} méter magasságban repült.
items.gloss_en: A different drone flew at an altitude of {D} meters that same day.
items.entity_note: a different drone, not the one whose landing and takeoff altitudes are given

items.distractor_fact: Egy másik csomag tömege feladáskor {D} kilogramm volt.
items.gloss_en: A different package's weight at shipping was {D} kilograms.
items.entity_note: a different package, not the one whose delivery and shipping weight are compared

items.distractor_fact: A szomszédos település lakossága ugyanabban az évben {D} fő volt.
items.gloss_en: The neighbouring settlement's population was {D} people in that same year.
items.entity_note: a different settlement's own population, not the village whose year-over-year change is asked about

items.distractor_fact: Egy másik autó sebessége ugyanazon az úton {D} kilométer per óra volt.
items.gloss_en: A different car's speed on that same road was {D} kilometers per hour.
items.entity_note: a different car, not the one whose speed at the two checkpoints is compared

items.distractor_fact: Egy másik takarékszámlára ugyanabban a hónapban {D} eurót fizettek be.
items.gloss_en: Into a different savings account, {D} euros were deposited in that same month.
items.entity_note: a different savings account, not the one whose deposits and withdrawals set the balance

items.distractor_fact: Egy másik háztartás bevétele ugyanabban a hónapban {D} forint volt.
items.gloss_en: A different household's income in that same month was {D} forints.
items.entity_note: a different household, not the one whose income and expenses give the net result

items.distractor_fact: Egy másik csapat a szezonban {D} gólt szerzett.
items.gloss_en: A different team scored {D} goals in the season.
items.entity_note: a rival team's own tally, not the team whose scored/conceded goals give its goal difference

items.distractor_fact: Egy másik gyár a hónapban {D} darabot gyártott.
items.gloss_en: A different factory produced {D} units in the month.
items.entity_note: a different factory with its own unstated plan, not the factory whose production is compared to its stated target

items.distractor_fact: A szomszédos településen ugyanazon a napon {D} milliméter csapadék hullott.
items.gloss_en: In the neighbouring settlement, {D} millimeters of rain fell that same day.
items.entity_note: a different settlement's own rainfall, not the town whose rainfall is compared to its stated forecast

items.distractor_fact: Egy másik játékos egy másik lyukon {D} ütést használt.
items.gloss_en: A different player used {D} strokes on a different hole.
items.entity_note: a different player on a different hole whose par is not stated, not this hole's par comparison

items.distractor_fact: Egy másik vonat egy másik vonalon a(z) {D}. percben futott be.
items.gloss_en: A different train on a different line arrived at minute {D}.
items.entity_note: a different train on a different line and timetable, not the train whose arrival is compared to its own schedule
